Successful Thesis Defense of Jan Klimke

On Monday April 8th 2019 Jan Klimke successfully defended his doctoral thesis titled "Web-Based Provisioning and Application of Large-Scale Virtual 3D City Models". In his thesis he addresses issues for image-based provisioning of virtual 3D city models that arise from size, heterogeneity and complexity of such models.
